selection_rule: Use complete official NIST standard-reference-data pages and certificates, the complete official NASA/JPL line-catalog record selected by fixed identity, complete NIST diffraction/electrophoretic/electroanalytical records, complete IUPAC terminology and method records, and the immutable admitted ANAL-001-011 evidence surfaces. Capture linked machine-readable records discovered only through these identities. Preserve every favorable, adverse, absent, unavailable, unresolved, predicted, fitted, uncertain and superseded row on each registered surface.
development_exposure_disclosure: Before this registry and its seals, web identity/search surfaces exposed database coverage counts, source titles, measurement categories, selected example gas-chromatography rows, a benzene rotational-constant summary, selected NIST lattice-parameter values, qualitative electron/neutron diffraction scope, SRM 1980 particle dimensions and qualitative electroanalytical method descriptions. The eleven native laws and unique survivor strings were frozen first in analytical_terminal_laws_v1.py. Every exposed item remains development-observed and is never relabelled blind. No complete registered IR, UV-visible, mass, rotational, diffraction, retention, mobility, electroanalytical, multimodal or terminal-budget vector was captured or reconstructed before the seals.
